title: Introduce delta token system and shadow fusion for adaptive density across components
creator: Asha Menon
description: Establish a composable delta token approach to enable adaptive density variants (compact / default / spacious) and unify micro-shadow/elevation rules via a 'shadow fusion' layer. Goal is to reduce token duplication across components, make density toggles predictable, and provide an engineering-friendly token contract for runtime interpolation.
background: Recent product feedback and performance audits reveal inconsistent spacing and elevation across tables, cards, and form controls when density toggles are enabled. Multiple teams maintain divergent token aliases which makes rollouts brittle and increases QA surface area. Previous attempts to add density variants were ad-hoc (per-component overrides) and introduced visual regressions in charts and data tables.
goals: Define a minimal set of semantic base tokens and density delta tokens (delta-spacing, delta-radius, delta-shadow) to express compact/default/spacious variants
Design a 'shadow fusion' convention that composes elevation from base shadow channels and density deltas to produce stable, contrast-aware shadows across light/dark modes
Create a migration plan to replace 12+ per-component overrides with alias mapping and automated token transforms for engineering
Provide accessible contrast guardrails and examples for tables, buttons, and charts so density toggles do not degrade readability or data legibility
non_goals: Rewriting every component in the library during initial rollout (we will target high-impact surfaces first)
Replacing the entire iconography or color palette in this ticket (separate initiative)
Introducing runtime experimental interpolation SDKs in this phase (we will hand-off token defs and example transforms to engineering)
acceptance_criteria: Design token spec published with base tokens and density delta tokens documented in Confluence
Figma token library updated with token aliases and three density variants for buttons, tables, cards, and charts
Engineering has a mapping document and example transform scripts (lightweight JS) to produce runtime token bundles for each density
No visual regressions in core dashboard when toggling density (validated by component-focused QA checklist and screenshots)
Accessibility checklist passed for text contrast and interactive hit areas at compact density
deliverables: Design token JSON export (three density variants) for engineering
Migration guide for component owners and a small upgrade script for storybook snapshots
design_notes: Prefer semantic names over numeric scales for delta tokens: e.g., delta-space-compact-1, delta-radius-spacious-2
Shadow fusion uses three channels (ambient, key, penumbra) defined as baseShadow.* and density multipliers applied via delta-shadow.*
When combining color and elevation changes for charts, avoid increasing perceived contrast of data marks—test with real datasets
Provide token aliasing so legacy tokens map to new semantics during migration; do not remove old tokens until Deprecation Window + Migration Completed
engineering_notes: Suggested transform: runtimeToken = baseToken + densityDelta (simple numeric add for px-based tokens; multiplicative factors for shadows)
Provide example JS/TS helper (tokenTransform.ts) that accepts 'density' and 'mode' (light/dark) and returns resolved values
Work with infra to surface a small feature flag to toggle density at the org level for e2e testing
Add visual regression tests in Percy/Chromatic for representative pages (dashboard, user list, analytics chart)
Allocation: one eng PM pair to implement mapping + one SWE to support token export pipeline
migration_steps: Inventory current per-component overrides (initial list attached)
Create alias mapping table: OLD_TOKEN => NEW_ALIAS => density-resolved value
Implement token transform helper and publish npm package internally
Update stories in Storybook for buttons/tables/cards/charts to use alias tokens and add density knobs
Run phased rollout: design system package beta -> platform-owned components -> product teams -> full deprecation
Monitor visual regressions and customer-facing metrics for 2 weeks after each phase
risks: Compact density reduces touch targets — increases interaction failures if not handled with accessible hit-area overrides
Shadows in dark mode can produce washout on charts; require dataset-driven QA
Engineering bandwidth for token export pipeline may slip and delay rollout
Overly clever delta math could produce surprising pixel values on subpixel rendering — keep transforms simple and document rounding rules
